decks.notes: The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly build a board presence with efficient creatures like Bishop of Wings, Elvish Mystic, and Skyclave Apparition. Collected Company allows for card advantage and the ability to deploy threats at instant speed. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with creatures and gain life through cards like Righteous Valkyrie and Resplendent Angel. The mana base is designed for consistency and to support the deck's aggressive strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively attacking the opponent using creatures with haste and pump spells to maximize damage output. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional synergy and flexibility to the deck. By curving out with low-cost creatures and utilizing burn spells and combat tricks, this deck aims to pressure the opponent early and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. With a mix of direct damage, creature aggression, and versatile options, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with relentless pressure.

The main focus of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature damage and direct burn spells. The deck utilizes low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger to apply pressure early on, while also including spells like Titan's Strength and Ancestral Anger to increase their power and push for more damage. With the support of cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Monstrous Rage, this deck aims to maintain a relentless assault on the opponent and secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. It also aims to out-value the opponent using cards like Yorion, Sky Nomad and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck has a heavy emphasis on disruption and resource denial, making it difficult for the opponent to execute their game plan effectively. It aims to stabilize the board and take over the game in the mid to late game by consistently answering threats and generating card advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with low-cost creatures and aggressive spells. By utilizing the companion mechanic with Jegantha, the Wellspring, the deck gains additional mana advantage. The key strategy is to play efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, while also using burn spells like Ancestral Anger and Titan's Strength to finish off opponents. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent through fast-paced, proactive plays, often closing out games before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay by utilizing low-cost creatures with powerful abilities like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger. The goal is to quickly deal damage to the opponent while using spells like Titan's Strength and Monstrous Rage to enhance the creatures' damage output. Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance and Kumano Faces Kakkazan also provide additional ways to deal damage or control the board. The deck's synergy and efficient use of resources allow it to consistently apply pressure and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their game plan.

The main focus of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Resplendent Angel, Righteous Valkyrie, and Skyclave Apparition. Using cards like Collected Company and Kayla's Reconstruction to generate additional value, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of flying creatures, lifegain synergies, and efficient mana production from cards like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves. By utilizing a mix of creature aggression and strategic card advantage, the Selesnya Aggro deck aims to pressure opponents and maintain board control throughout the match.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to gain control of the game through various removal spells, counterspells, and card draw effects. The deck aims to control the board state with cards like Supreme Verdict and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Dovin's Veto and Get Lost. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents. Overall, the deck focuses on maintaining control of the game and outvaluing the opponent through card advantage and powerful control elements.

The main focus of this deck is to generate a large amount of green mana through devotion to Green cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Elvish Mystic. This mana is used to cast powerful creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, as well as spells like Storm the Festival. The deck also includes cards that provide additional benefits based on the amount of green mana available, such as Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Lair of the Hydra. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly ramping up mana production to overwhelm opponents with big threats.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, board wipes, and card advantage. It uses cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Memory Deluge to generate card advantage while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes removal spells like Supreme Verdict and Field of Ruin to deal with threats efficiently. The mana base is designed to support the control elements of the deck, with a mix of lands that produce both white and blue mana. Overall, the strategy revolves around outlasting the opponent and wearing them down over time.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through ramping up mana with cards like Lotus Cobra and Omnath, Locus of Creation, while also utilizing removal spells like Portable Hole and Ill-Timed Explosion. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value with flickering creatures and permanents. The deck also includes powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Kenrith, the Returned King to help maintain board presence and provide additional utility. The overall strategy is to control the game through ramping up mana and out-valuing opponents with powerful creatures and spells.

This combo deck aims to assemble the Lotus Field combo as quickly as possible to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful spells such as Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. The deck includes various ways to find and untap Lotus Field, as well as cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Dark Petition to tutor for key pieces. Boseiju, Who Endures protects important spells from countermagic, while Archdruid's Charm and Fae of Wishes offer versatile options for control and toolbox access. The deck is focused on setting up a strong board state and overwhelming the opponent with powerful spells.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to quickly play aggressive creatures and spells to deal damage to the opponent efficiently. The deck includes a variety of low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, along with pump spells like Titan's Strength and Monstrous Rage to increase their damage output. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional mana advantage. By utilizing fast creatures and burn spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly applying pressure to the opponent through a combination of aggressive creatures and disruption spells. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while also deploying efficient threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Graveyard Trespasser, the deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The inclusion of removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat helps to maintain board control, while powerful finishers like Archfiend of the Dross and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger can quickly end the game. The mana base is optimized to support the aggressive game plan, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistency.

The main concept of this deck is to combine The Wandering Emperor with Indomitable Creativity to create powerful creature tokens and/or bring out powerful creatures from the deck. The deck utilizes a combination of card draw, removal, and protection spells to set up the combo and control the board. Caretaker's Talent and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional support for generating tokens and protecting key pieces. The deck also includes efficient removal such as Torch the Tower and Volcanic Spite, as well as additional win conditions like Sunfall and Agent of Treachery.

The deck focuses on quickly disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Archfiend of the Dross. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the board. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements, with cards like Blightstep Pathway and Blackcleave Cliffs. Overall, this Rakdos Aggro deck aims to win the game by combining disruptive elements with a fast clock to overwhelm the opponent.
